name: LG reference feature injection
plain: After CFG, pushes the output toward a reference latent with a strength that decays linearly over a window. Its direction is limited to three times the std of the CFG result. Named noise injection, but no noise is used.
math:
p=1−min(σ,1). f=r−x_cfg; if std(f)>3std(x_cfg): f scaled down. x=x_cfg+f·m·k(1−(p−a)/(b−a)).
Note the hook works on the cond and uncond terms of cfg_function and treats σ as flow progress.
label: from code
surprise: Progress uses σ directly, so on EDM models with σ>1 it reads as progress 0 until σ falls below 1.
